place.name: 漢翔台中廠區周邊（航空產業代表地點）
place.nameEn: AIDC Taichung campus area — representative aerospace location
place.mapQuery: 漢翔航空工業股份有限公司 臺中市西屯區漢翔路1號

summary: 經國號的公開歷史，可以讀成一條從原型機出廠、首次飛行到生產階段完成的工程學習路線。這些節點的意義不同：外觀完整、開始飛行與穩定生產，分別需要不同的證據。本地點以漢翔台中廠區代表台灣航空製造網絡，並非宣稱全部工序集中於此；課程限於公開歷史、製造品質與工程安全。
summaryEn: The public history of the Indigenous Defense Fighter offers a learning sequence from prototype rollout through first flight to completion of the production phase. These milestones require different evidence: a complete exterior, a flying prototype and repeatable production are distinct achievements. AIDC’s Taichung campus represents a wider aerospace network, rather than every production operation. The course covers public history, manufacturing quality and engineering safety.

history.title: 首架原型機出廠
history.text: 1988年12月10日，首架原型機A1出廠，並獲命名為經國號。對學徒而言，這是理解原型機與量產件差別的起點：展示一架整合完成的機體，不等於每項驗證都已完成。
history.textEn: The first A1 prototype rolled out on 10 December 1988 and received the Ching-kuo name. This milestone introduces the distinction between a prototype and a production article: presenting an integrated airframe is different from completing every verification activity.

history.title: 首次飛行
history.text: 1989年5月28日完成首次飛行。將它與前一年的出廠日期並列，可以看見「組合完成」與「進入飛行驗證」之間仍有一段工程工作；課程以公開里程碑練習安排驗證關卡。
history.textEn: The first flight took place on 28 May 1989. Comparing this date with rollout makes the interval between physical integration and flight verification visible. Learners use these public milestones to reason about verification gates.

history.title: 生產階段完成
history.text: 漢翔的公開沿革記載，1999年底完成第130架量產機，結束該生產階段。這提供一個討論重複製造的切入點：工程圖版本、零件追溯與檢驗紀錄，如何讓不同批次維持一致。
history.textEn: AIDC records completion of the 130th production aircraft at the end of 1999, closing that production phase. This provides a starting point for discussing repeatability: drawing revisions, part traceability and inspection records help control variation between batches.

connection: 相鄰的土木工程課題是機棚、跑道與製造廠房：機體、地面設備及建築空間必須使用一致的尺寸介面。可先用民用機棚的示意模型練習淨空、通道和維修動線，再把「有圖、有量測、有驗證」的思考轉移到橋梁構件或捷運車體；不延伸至武器製造。
connectionEn: Adjacent civil-engineering topics include hangars, runways and manufacturing buildings, where aircraft, ground equipment and structures share dimensional interfaces. Use a conceptual civilian hangar model to study clearances, access and maintenance routes, then transfer drawing, measurement and verification habits to bridge components or metro bodies. Weapon construction is outside this course.

place.name: 波音梅薩據點周邊（代表地點）
place.nameEn: Boeing Mesa site area — representative location
place.mapQuery: Boeing Mesa 5000 East McDowell Road Arizona

summary: 阿帕契的公開故事跨越原型試飛與長期製造。波音官方介紹將梅薩列為建造及測試所在地，因此本課程用它作為旋翼航空產業的代表地點。學習重點是公開的發展時間線、品質管理與安全意識；地圖不表示廠區開放參觀，也不提供武器、戰術或作戰系統的製作細節。
summaryEn: The Apache’s public story spans prototype flight and long-term manufacturing. Boeing identifies Mesa as a location where Apaches are built and tested, so this course uses it to represent the rotorcraft industry. Learning focuses on the public timeline, quality management and safety. The map does not imply public access, and the course provides no weapon, tactical or combat-system construction details.

history.title: 原型機首次飛行
history.text: 波音在首飛25週年的官方回顧中記載，首次飛行發生於1975年9月30日。把原型階段放在時間線的前端，有助於理解研發驗證與日後交付並不是同一件事。
history.textEn: Boeing’s official 25th-anniversary account dates the first flight to 30 September 1975. Placing the prototype phase at the beginning of the timeline helps separate development verification from later delivery.

history.title: 開始交付
history.text: 波音官方資料記載首批交付始於1984年。首飛到交付的多年跨度，可用來討論複雜航空專案如何逐步成熟；不能把兩個年份之間的全部工作，簡化成一條固定的組裝配方。
history.textEn: Boeing dates the first deliveries to 1984. The years between first flight and delivery support discussion of how a complex aviation project matures; they should not be reduced to a single universal assembly recipe.

connection: 可轉向民用旋翼機的機棚、停機坪與救援基地，研究建築淨空、消防分區及地面作業流程。再與捷運維修廠比較：兩者都需要把設備、工作人員與檢驗紀錄安排成可追溯的流程，但運動型態、載荷與適用規範不同。
connectionEn: A useful civilian connection is the design of rotorcraft hangars, aprons and rescue bases: building clearances, fire compartments and ground workflows must fit their users. Compare these with metro maintenance depots. Both organize equipment, people and inspection records into traceable processes, while their motion, loads and governing standards differ.

place.name: 台船高雄總廠周邊（造船產業代表地點）
place.nameEn: CSBC Kaohsiung shipyard area — representative shipbuilding location
place.mapQuery: 台船高雄總廠 高雄市小港區中鋼路3號

summary: 海鯤原型艦的公開歷史，適合用來辨識大型造船案的不同階段：開工、命名與下水典禮，各自只代表特定的進展。高雄台船據點是本課程的產業地理錨點，不是開放參觀或所有工序的保證。教學採公開歷史、一般造船品質與安全管理，不涉及作戰性能或潛艦製造參數。
summaryEn: The public history of the Hai Kun prototype helps distinguish stages in a large shipbuilding project: construction commencement, naming and a launch ceremony each mark specific progress. CSBC’s Kaohsiung site is the course’s industrial geography anchor, not a promise of public access or a claim that every operation occurs there. Teaching covers public history, general shipbuilding quality and safety, without combat performance or submarine manufacturing parameters.

history.title: 建造案開工典禮
history.text: 2020年11月24日，總統府記錄了在高雄台船公司舉行的建造案開工典禮。公開敘述提到預算、簽約、設計與廠房準備，提醒學徒：可見的製造工作之前，已存在專案與基礎設施的準備。
history.textEn: The Presidential Office records a construction commencement ceremony at CSBC in Kaohsiung on 24 November 2020. Its public account describes prior budgeting, contracting, design and facility preparation, showing that project and infrastructure work precedes visible manufacturing.

history.title: 命名暨下水典禮
history.text: 2023年9月28日舉行原型艦命名暨下水典禮，名稱為海鯤。這裡保留官方對事件的稱呼，不把典禮日期改寫成完成全部測試、交付或服役日期；大型專案需要逐項辨識驗證狀態。
history.textEn: The prototype naming and launch ceremony was held on 28 September 2023, with the name Hai Kun. The event is kept distinct from completion of all testing, delivery or commissioning. Large projects require verification status to be identified milestone by milestone.

connection: 相鄰課題可選港灣、船塢與民用船舶：比較塢體、排水設備、起重設施和人員通道如何共同服務建造流程。可用一般貨船的分段示意圖學習工序依賴、檢驗停留點與防蝕紀錄，再與橋梁鋼構的製造追溯比較。
connectionEn: Adjacent topics include harbors, dry docks and civilian vessels. Compare how dock structures, drainage, lifting facilities and personnel access support a construction workflow. A generic cargo-ship block diagram can teach dependencies, inspection hold points and corrosion-protection records, then be compared with traceability for fabricated bridge steelwork.

place.name: 淡江大橋主橋周邊（代表位置）
place.nameEn: Danjiang Bridge main crossing — representative location
place.city: 新北市淡水區與八里區
place.cityEn: Tamsui and Bali districts, New Taipei City

summary: 淡江大橋把跨河交通、結構工程和淡水河口景觀放進同一個設計問題。它的故事不只是一座橋塔的造型：橋型競圖、施工合龍、設備整備及開放交通，是不同的決策與驗證階段。地圖標示主橋周邊的概略代表位置，適合與淡水、八里及河口地形一同觀察。
summaryEn: Danjiang Bridge brings river-crossing transport, structural engineering and the Tamsui estuary landscape into one design problem. Its story extends beyond the tower’s appearance: the design competition, structural closure, system readiness and opening to traffic are different decision and verification stages. The map marks an approximate representative location at the main crossing for reading the bridge alongside Tamsui, Bali and the estuary.

history.title: 橋型國際競圖完成
history.text: 公路局回顧記載，國際競圖於2015年8月完成，選定單塔不對稱斜張橋。地方文化、夕照景觀與環境條件參與了方案選擇，說明工程需求可以同時包含交通功能與場所感。
history.textEn: The Highway Bureau’s retrospective dates completion of the international competition to August 2015, selecting a single-tower asymmetrical cable-stayed form. Local culture, sunset views and environmental conditions informed the choice, illustrating how engineering requirements can include both transport function and sense of place.

history.title: 主橋合龍
history.text: 公路局記載2025年9月16日完成合龍。合龍後仍需照明、鋪面、索力調整、吊車拆除、載重試驗及查驗等整備；「結構接起來」並不直接等於「已可通車」。
history.textEn: The Highway Bureau records bridge closure on 16 September 2025. Lighting, paving, cable-force adjustment, crane removal, load testing and inspection followed. Connecting the structure was therefore distinct from being ready for traffic.

history.title: 正式開放車輛通行
history.text: 依公路局2026年5月13日說明，5月9日舉辦啟用活動，5月12日上午11時30分正式通車。這裡以已公布的實際事件區分活動日與交通開放日，不沿用早期預定完工日期。
history.textEn: According to the Highway Bureau’s 13 May 2026 statement, inauguration activities took place on 9 May and traffic formally opened at 11:30 on 12 May. These reported events distinguish the ceremony from traffic access rather than repeating earlier projected completion dates.

connection: 可與雪山隧道比較「跨越障礙」的兩種方法：橋梁把路線抬過河口，隧道讓路線穿過山體。總工程師仍需統整地質、水文、結構、施工順序及使用者安全；學生可建立共同的需求清單，再標出河道與地下環境各自新增的限制。
connectionEn: Compare two ways of crossing an obstacle: the bridge carries a route over an estuary, while Hsuehshan Tunnel carries one through a mountain. Both require coordination of geology, water, structures, construction sequence and user safety. Learners can create a shared requirements list and then identify the distinct constraints imposed by a river channel and an underground setting.

place.name: 雪山隧道文物館（南口代表地點）
place.nameEn: Hsuehshan Tunnel Museum — south-portal representative location
place.mapQuery: 雪山隧道文物館 宜蘭縣頭城鎮北宜路一段223巷60號

summary: 雪山隧道的故事，是地質不確定性、施工方法與長期協作交織的案例。南口文物館保留隧道鑽掘機模型、剖面與施工歷程，讓看不見的地下工作有了可觀察的入口。從導坑開工到通車的時間線，也提醒學徒把貫通、設備整合與營運準備分開理解。
summaryEn: Hsuehshan Tunnel is a case study in geological uncertainty, construction methods and sustained collaboration. The museum near the south portal uses tunnel-boring-machine models, sections and construction records to make underground work observable. Its timeline from pilot-tunnel construction to traffic opening also separates breakthrough from system integration and operational readiness.

history.title: 導坑工程開工
history.text: 高速公路局大事紀記錄1991年7月15日導坑工程開工。先把導坑與後續主隧道區分，能幫助學徒理解不同工作面、地質資訊及施工階段之間的關係。
history.textEn: The Freeway Bureau dates the start of pilot-tunnel construction to 15 July 1991. Distinguishing the pilot tunnel from the later main tunnels helps learners relate work fronts, geological information and construction stages.

history.title: 全線貫通
history.text: 2004年9月16日完成全線貫通。這是地下開挖的重要節點，卻仍不是車流可以立即進入的終點；課程把它作為從土建工作轉向後續系統整備的討論關卡。
history.textEn: Full breakthrough was achieved on 16 September 2004. It was a major excavation milestone, but did not itself mean traffic could immediately enter. The course uses it to discuss the transition from civil construction to subsequent system readiness.

history.title: 通車營運
history.text: 2006年6月16日通車。將此日期與2004年的貫通並列，可練習追問：在一條可安全使用的公路隧道裡，除了空間被挖通，還必須準備哪些設備、程序與驗證證據？
history.textEn: The tunnel opened to traffic on 16 June 2006. Setting this beside the 2004 breakthrough invites a practical question: beyond an excavated passage, which systems, procedures and verification evidence are needed for a usable road tunnel?

connection: 相鄰工程可連到捷運隧道、抽水站與地下車站。用原創剖面圖標示交通空間、排水及通風的介面，再比較道路隧道與軌道隧道的使用情境。這種介面分析可延伸至礦山、地下實驗室與大型建築的機電整合。
connectionEn: Related civil works include metro tunnels, pumping stations and underground stations. Use an original section diagram to mark interfaces among traffic space, drainage and ventilation, then compare road and rail operating contexts. This interface analysis also transfers to mines, underground laboratories and building-services integration.

place.name: 英國國家鐵路博物館
place.mapQuery: National Railway Museum Leeman Road York

summary: 約克的國家鐵路博物館讓蒸汽機車從退役設備變成可持續研究的工程證據。以Mallard與A4系列為一個具體入口，可以把熱機、車輪連桿、車體外形與鐵路系統放在一起觀察；它只是眾多蒸汽機車設計中的一支，不能代表所有年代與國家的製造方法。
summaryEn: York’s National Railway Museum turns retired railway equipment into enduring engineering evidence. Mallard and the A4 family provide a concrete entry point for observing heat engines, wheel linkages, body form and the railway system together. They represent one design family, not the manufacturing methods of every period or country.

history.title: Mallard的速度紀錄
history.text: 1938年7月3日，Mallard達到每小時126英里的蒸汽機車速度紀錄。課程不把紀錄視為日常運行條件，而是請學徒分辨單次試驗成果、日常服務與維修負擔這三種不同問題。
history.textEn: On 3 July 1938, Mallard reached a steam-locomotive speed record of 126 mph. The course treats this as a record run rather than a routine operating condition, inviting learners to distinguish a test achievement, everyday service and maintenance burden.

history.title: 舊車庫成為公共博物館
history.titleEn: A former depot becomes a public museum
history.text: 國家鐵路博物館於1975年在約克開館，利用舊有動力車庫轉作展示空間。工程故事因此多了一層：保存機車也需要建築再利用、展品支承與知識整理。
history.textEn: The National Railway Museum opened in York in 1975, adapting a former motive-power depot for display. This adds another engineering layer: preserving locomotives also involves building reuse, exhibit support and the organization of knowledge.

history.title: 六輛存世A4機車相聚
history.text: 為紀念Mallard紀錄75週年，六輛存世A4機車於2013年在約克相聚。並置觀察提供一個學習方法：同一設計家族的外觀相似，不表示每輛車的使用經歷與保存狀態相同。
history.textEn: For the record’s 75th anniversary, all six surviving A4 locomotives gathered in York in 2013. Side-by-side observation offers a learning method: similar appearance within a design family does not imply identical service histories or conservation condition.

connection: 蒸汽機車能連到鐵路橋梁、路基、車站與給水設施：車輛再強，也必須與軌道承載、轉彎及服務設施共同工作。可用縮尺示意模型比較蒸汽與電力牽引的能量流，再討論歷史車庫改作博物館時的結構與保存需求；不進行實體鍋爐製造或加壓實驗。
connectionEn: Steam locomotives connect naturally to railway bridges, track foundations, stations and water facilities: a vehicle works within track-load, curve and servicing constraints. Use a scale schematic to compare steam and electric traction energy flows, then discuss structural and conservation needs when adapting a historic depot into a museum. No physical boiler construction or pressurization experiment is involved.

place.name: 三峽大壩與三斗坪周邊（代表位置）
place.nameEn: Three Gorges Dam and Sandouping area — representative location
place.mapQuery: Three Gorges Dam Sandouping Yichang Hubei

summary: 三峽工程適合用「一個水利樞紐，多種相互牽動的功能」來閱讀：大壩、水庫、電站與通航設施需要共同運作。三斗坪的地理位置讓學徒能從河流尺度理解工地，而不是只看一座混凝土構造物。工程課程也應把長期維護、上下游使用者與環境影響列入問題清單。
summaryEn: The Three Gorges project is best read as one water-control complex with interacting functions: the dam, reservoir, power station and navigation facilities operate together. Its Sandouping location lets learners consider the river scale rather than only a concrete structure. Long-term maintenance, upstream and downstream users, and environmental effects also belong in the engineering questions.

history.title: 工程正式開工
history.text: 三峽集團記載，工程於1994年12月14日正式開工。這是理解大型分期工程的起點：施工準備、河道處理與永久設施並非同時完成，時間線需要顯示各階段的依賴。
history.textEn: China Three Gorges records the formal start of construction on 14 December 1994. It provides a starting point for studying phased works: preparation, river management and permanent facilities are not completed simultaneously, so the timeline must reveal dependencies.

history.title: 蓄水、通航與發電進入新階段
history.titleEn: Impoundment, navigation and power enter a new phase
history.text: 2003年完成二期工程蓄水、通航與發電目標。三項里程碑放在同一年，不代表它們是同一個動作；課程可分別畫出水庫、船閘及機組的功能介面，討論跨系統驗證。
history.textEn: In 2003 the project achieved its second-phase goals for impoundment, navigation and power generation. Occurring in one year does not make these a single operation. Learners can map reservoir, lock and generating-unit interfaces separately to discuss verification across systems.

history.title: 主發電機組全部投運
history.titleEn: All main generating units enter operation
history.text: 長江電力的工程介紹記載，2012年7月全部32台70萬千瓦主機組投入運行。從1994年的開工走到機組陸續投運，顯示大型基礎設施往往以分期建造、分期使用的方式形成。
history.textEn: China Yangtze Power records all 32 main 700 MW generating units entering operation in July 2012. The interval from the 1994 start to successive unit commissioning illustrates how large infrastructure can be built and brought into use in phases.

connection: 可連到抽蓄水力、船閘、河港與跨河橋梁。先用水位與能量的示意模型區分發電、調蓄及船舶通過的目的，再比較不同操作情境的限制。工程成功的討論應同時提出結構安全、設備可靠性與河川系統影響的證據需求。
connectionEn: Related topics include pumped storage, navigation locks, river ports and bridges. Begin with schematic water-level and energy models to distinguish generation, storage and vessel passage, then compare constraints under different operating scenarios. Evaluating success should identify evidence needs for structural safety, equipment reliability and effects on the river system.

place.name: 臺北捷運動物園站（木柵線歷史代表地點）
place.nameEn: Taipei Zoo Station — representative historic Muzha Line location
place.mapQuery: 臺北捷運動物園站 臺北市文山區新光路2段32號

summary: 動物園站把抽象的捷運系統落在一個可以辨識的城市地點。臺北捷運從木柵線的中運量系統開始，逐步加入不同路線與運輸型式。車輛、軌道、控制、供電和車站需要彼此配合，因此本課程把「能動的車」與「能持續服務的路網」當成不同層次的工程目標。
summaryEn: Taipei Zoo Station anchors an abstract metro system in a recognizable urban place. Taipei Metro began with the medium-capacity Muzha Line and expanded into a network with different lines and system types. Vehicles, guideways, control, power and stations must work together, so this course distinguishes a moving vehicle from a network capable of sustained service.

history.title: 木柵線開始營運
history.text: 1996年3月28日，木柵線通車，成為臺北捷運首條營運路線。它提供一個具體的系統邊界：車站、導軌與自動化車輛必須一起被理解，不能只把捷運看成車頭與車廂。
history.textEn: On 28 March 1996, the Muzha Line became Taipei Metro’s first operating line. It offers a concrete system boundary: stations, guideways and automated vehicles must be understood together rather than reducing a metro to a train and its cars.

history.title: 高運量淡水線加入
history.text: 臺北捷運大事紀記載，1997年3月28日淡水線淡水至中山段通車。從中運量到高運量，可練習比較運輸需求與系統選型；不同路線不能直接套用相同的車輛及控制假設。
history.textEn: Taipei Metro’s chronology records the Tamsui-to-Zhongshan section opening on 28 March 1997. The addition of a high-capacity line supports comparison of demand and system selection; identical vehicle and control assumptions cannot simply be applied to every line.

history.title: 內湖線延伸與系統相容
history.text: 2009年7月4日內湖線通車，與既有木柵線銜接。捷運工程局指出，新舊機電系統相容是擴充時的重要課題；這個故事適合用來討論延伸一條運行中的路線，為何涉及既有介面的整合。
history.textEn: The Neihu extension opened on 4 July 2009 and connected with the existing Muzha Line. The Department of Rapid Transit Systems identifies compatibility between the new and existing electromechanical systems as a key expansion issue, illustrating why extending an operating route requires interface integration.

connection: 相鄰土木工程包括高架橋、隧道、地下車站與維修機廠。可把同一段捷運需求分配到車輛、供電、訊號及土建四張示意圖，再檢查月台介面、設備空間和維修通道是否一致。這種跨專業比對也適用於機場、港口與大型醫院。
connectionEn: Adjacent civil works include viaducts, tunnels, underground stations and maintenance depots. Allocate the requirements for one metro section across vehicle, power, signaling and civil schematics, then compare platform interfaces, equipment space and maintenance access. This cross-discipline checking also applies to airports, ports and large hospitals.
